text: The JRSM‑1 Flood Protection Parametric Insurance Scheme is a pilot initiative in Bangladesh designed to provide rapid cash payouts to low-income households in the Char areas of Sirajganj district when a predefined flood-depth index is triggered. Developed by Oxfam and Swiss Re, the scheme uses a parametric index based on flood-water depths to determine payouts, aiming to protect vulnerable communities from the fiscal impacts of riverine floods.
